question: Who has been nominated as a member on the GAVI Board by the Global Alliance for Vaccines and Immunisation in December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Harsh Vardhan.__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Harsh Vardhan**__ was nominated as a member of the GAVI Board by the Global Alliance for Vaccines and Immunisation in December 2020.
 
• He will be representing the South East Area Regional Office(SEARO)/ Western Pacific Regional Office (WPRO) constituency on the GAVI Board.
 
• **Mr MyintHtwe **of Myanmar previously holds the seat.
 
• Dr Harsh Va
